title: AssessmentStatus + remedy_class (extension X3)
description: Extends review_record.schema.json -> criterion_assessments[] with the agent's output status and, for SPEC_INSUFFICIENT, the class of remedy required. mode is a construct of spec-authoring time; status is what the downstream consumer sees. If four distinct modes all collapse back to one SPEC_INSUFFICIENT, the distinction dies at the delivery boundary.
$comment: HOST: review_record.schema.json -> criterion_assessments[] items -> add `status` and `remedy_class`.

status.description: EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT: the spec is clear, this chart lacks the evidence. Owner is always the Adjudicator, so it needs no subdivision. SPEC_INSUFFICIENT: something upstream of this patient is wrong — see remedy_class.

remedy_class.description: Required iff status = SPEC_INSUFFICIENT. Decision rule: does the remedy affect one case, every case of this criterion, or the pipeline? FIX_SPEC -> Definer edits the spec once, all affected cases rerun. WRONG_DATA_SOURCE -> the field must come from elsewhere; the agent should never be asked this variable again (and the compiler should refuse to emit the task at all). REQUIRES_HUMAN_AUTHORITY -> the spec is clear but deliberately withholds discretion from the agent; route to a registrar who holds it.

blocking_reason.description: Populated on gate failure so a human receives an actionable gap list.

required_fields.description: For WRONG_DATA_SOURCE: which external fields would answer this, e.g. 'NAACCR 610 Class of Case'.

$comment_relationship: NOT the same thing as review_record.reviewer_overrides[].error_category (missed_evidence / misinterpreted / wrong_rule / criterion_ambiguous / other). That is a human's post-hoc attribution of what went wrong; remedy_class is the agent's own output state saying who must act next. Complementary, not redundant — do not merge them.
